scheme_plusplus.theorem: For A=Df C+C Df: Vpᵀ A Vp = 2p Vpᵀ Df Vp.  Proof: C=p(P₊−P₋) ⇒ P₊ A P₊ = 2p P₊ Df P₊.

scheme_in_ker.theorem: sum f=0 ⇒ uᵀ(2p Vpᵀ Df Vp)u = 2p ∑ f_i y_i² = 0 on Max+.  scheme-image ⊆ ker Q₊.

ortho_diag.theorem: ⟨M, Vpᵀ Df Vp⟩_F = ∑ f_i B_ii for B=Vp M Vpᵀ.  M ⊥ scheme-image (all ∑f=0) ⇔ B has constant diagonal; with Tr M=0 ⇒ zero diagonal.

wick.theorem: B=P₊BP₊, zero diagonal, S=2P₊: SB=2B, Tr(SB)=0, Tr(SBSB)=4‖B‖_F² ⇒ E_Wick[(yᵀBy)²]=8‖B‖_F².

reduction.theorem: ker=sc for all p≥5 once G₊ ≻ 0 on 𝒲₊₊⁰ (and the Max− twin), by the decomposition A=A₊₊+A₋₋+A× and (A)–(E).  G₊≻0 on 𝒲₊₊⁰ ⇔ ker Q₊ = scheme-image.
